title: Punjab Private Security Companies Regulation and Control Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Private Security Companies Regulation and Control Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2004
ACT XIII OF 2004
PUNJAB PRIVATE
SECURITY COMPANIES
(REGULATION AND
CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend
the Punjab Security Companies
(Regulation and
Control) Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 9th June, 2004]
No.PAP-Legis-2(4)/2004/624,
dated 8-6-2004.-------The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and
Control) (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab on 31st May, 2004, and assented to by the Governor of
the Punjab on 5th June, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Private Security
Companies (Regulation and Control) (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Private Security Companies Regulation and Control Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Addition of section 5-A in Ordinance LXIX of 2002

ACT XIII OF 2004
ACT XIII OF 2004
PUNJAB PRIVATE
SECURITY COMPANIES
(REGULATION AND
CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend
the Punjab Security Companies
(Regulation and
Control) Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 9th June, 2004]
No.PAP-Legis-2(4)/2004/624,
dated 8-6-2004.-------The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and
Control) (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab on 31st May, 2004, and assented to by the Governor of
the Punjab on 5th June, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
2. Addition of section 5-A in
Ordinance LXIX of 2002.----In the said Ordinance, after section 5, the
following new section 5-A shall be added:--
"5-A. Prohibition of
cash-in-transit.-No Private Security Company shall undertake the business
of transit of cash or valuable articles unless a No Objection Certificate has
been issued by the Licensing Authority in this regard.".
